analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Create and validate a smoke test framework for constitution generation processes to ensure system reliability and governance compliance
requirements_understanding: Need to establish automated testing for constitution generation workflows
Must validate that constitutional constraints are properly applied
Requires verification of governance rule enforcement
Need observability into constitution creation and validation processes
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement test harness with configurable constitution templates
Build validation engine for constitutional rule compliance
Create monitoring and alerting for constitution generation failures
Design API contracts for constitution CRUD operations
clarifications_requested: What specific constitutional domains need smoke testing coverage?
Are there existing constitution templates that must be preserved?
What compliance frameworks must be validated during testing?

output.executive_summary: Develop a comprehensive smoke testing framework to validate constitution generation processes, ensuring reliability, compliance, and proper governance rule enforcement across all constitutional workflows.

functional_requirements.title: Constitution Template Management
functional_requirements.description: System shall provide CRUD operations for managing constitution templates with version control and approval workflows
acceptance_criteria: User can create new constitution templates with mandatory metadata fields
System maintains version history for all template modifications
Template approval workflow requires authorized reviewer sign-off before activation

functional_requirements.title: Automated Constitution Generation
functional_requirements.description: System shall generate constitutions from templates with parameter substitution and rule validation
acceptance_criteria: Constitution generation completes within 30 seconds for standard templates
All template parameters are validated before substitution occurs
Generated constitutions pass automated compliance rule checks

functional_requirements.title: Smoke Test Execution Engine
functional_requirements.description: System shall execute configurable smoke tests against constitution generation workflows
acceptance_criteria: Smoke tests can be scheduled to run at configurable intervals
Test results include pass/fail status with detailed error reporting
Failed tests trigger immediate alerts to designated stakeholders

functional_requirements.title: Constitution Validation Framework
functional_requirements.description: System shall validate generated constitutions against predefined governance rules and constraints
acceptance_criteria: Validation engine checks all mandatory constitutional sections are present
System verifies compliance with organizational governance standards
Validation results are logged with timestamp and rule references

functional_requirements.title: Test Data Management
functional_requirements.description: System shall manage test datasets for constitution generation scenarios including edge cases
acceptance_criteria: Test data can be imported from external sources in JSON/XML formats
System provides data anonymization for sensitive test scenarios
Test datasets are versioned and linked to specific test configurations

functional_requirements.title: Constitution Comparison and Diff Analysis
functional_requirements.description: System shall compare generated constitutions against baseline versions to detect unexpected changes
acceptance_criteria: Diff analysis highlights structural and content changes between versions
Comparison results are exportable in multiple formats (HTML, PDF, JSON)
System maintains baseline constitution snapshots for regression testing

functional_requirements.title: Reporting and Analytics Dashboard
functional_requirements.description: System shall provide comprehensive reporting on constitution generation test results and trends
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays real-time test execution status and historical trends
Reports can be filtered by date range, test type, and success/failure status
Automated reports are generated and distributed to stakeholders weekly

functional_requirements.title: API Integration for External Systems
functional_requirements.description: System shall expose REST APIs for integration with external constitution management systems
acceptance_criteria: API endpoints support standard HTTP methods with proper status codes
All API requests and responses are logged for audit purposes
API documentation is auto-generated and maintained with version updates

non_functional_requirements.title: System Performance
non_functional_requirements.description: Constitution generation and testing processes must meet defined performance benchmarks
non_functional_requirements.metric: 95% of constitution generations complete within 30 seconds, smoke tests execute within 5 minutes
acceptance_criteria: System handles concurrent constitution generation requests up to 50 simultaneous users
Database queries for template retrieval complete within 2 seconds
Memory usage remains below 4GB during peak testing operations

non_functional_requirements.title: System Reliability
non_functional_requirements.description: Constitution generation framework must maintain high availability and fault tolerance
non_functional_requirements.metric: 99.5% uptime with automatic recovery from transient failures
acceptance_criteria: System automatically retries failed constitution generations up to 3 times
Database connection failures are handled with exponential backoff retry logic
System maintains operation during planned maintenance windows using blue-green deployment

non_functional_requirements.title: Security and Access Control
non_functional_requirements.description: System must enforce proper authentication, authorization, and data protection measures
non_functional_requirements.metric: All API endpoints require valid authentication tokens, sensitive data encrypted at rest and in transit
acceptance_criteria: User authentication integrates with existing organizational identity provider
Role-based access control restricts constitution template modifications to authorized users
All constitution data is encrypted using AES-256 encryption standards

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability and Resource Management
non_functional_requirements.description: System architecture must support horizontal scaling and efficient resource utilization
non_functional_requirements.metric: System scales to handle 10x current load with linear resource increase
acceptance_criteria: Constitution generation workers can be dynamically scaled based on queue depth
Database connection pooling optimizes resource usage during peak loads
System monitoring provides early warning when scaling thresholds are approached

non_functional_requirements.title: Observability and Monitoring
non_functional_requirements.description: System must provide comprehensive logging, metrics, and alerting capabilities
non_functional_requirements.metric: All critical operations logged with structured data, 100% test execution visibility
acceptance_criteria: Application logs include correlation IDs for tracing requests across components
Metrics dashboard provides real-time visibility into system health and performance
Alert notifications are sent within 60 seconds of detecting critical failures

recommended_strategy.name: Phased modernization
recommended_strategy.rationale: Preserve behavior first, then modernize in controlled phases.

phases.title: Baseline and equivalence harness
phases.outcome: Capture golden flows and baseline outputs.

phases.title: Incremental migration and dependency replacement
phases.outcome: Migrate forms/modules with dependency risk controls.

phases.title: Hardening and release evidence
phases.outcome: Finalize quality gates and publish evidence pack.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.

phase_outline: Phase 1: form/module migration with dependency replacement
Phase 2: hardening, governance gates, and evidence publication

principles: Preserve critical legacy behavior first; modernization must prove functional equivalence.
Every modernization decision must map to explicit evidence (code, query, event, or rule).
No breaking change to data contracts without approved migration path and rollback evidence.
